---

```{=html}
<div id="figure-editor" class="fe-mount"></div>
<noscript><p>The Figure Editor needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./src/index.js";
  // The samples ship with the Schematic Editor: ?open=examples/... means its examples.
  const open = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("open");
  const tool = await mount(document.getElementById("figure-editor"), {
    pack: "../schematic-editor/symbol-pack/",
    open: open && open.startsWith("examples/") ? `../schematic-editor/${open}` : open,
  });
  window.figureEditorTool = tool;   // the shared interface (load, save, on, command, ...)
  window.figureEditor = tool.app;   // the editor's own API, for the page and its browser checks
</script>
```
